MOD = 10**9 + 7

def countPalindromicPaths(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    m = len(matrix[0])
    
    # dp[i][j] will store the number of palindromic paths ending at (i, j)
    dp = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Initialize the top-left corner
    dp[0][0] = 1
    
    # Fill the first row
    for j in range(1, m):
        if matrix[0][j] == matrix[0][j-1]:
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j-1]
    
    # Fill the first column
    for i in range(1, n):
        if matrix[i][0] == matrix[i-1][0]:
            dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][0]
    
    # Fill the rest of the dp table
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(1, m):
            if matrix[i][j] == matrix[i-1][j]:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i-1][j]
            if matrix[i][j] == matrix[i][j-1]:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i][j-1]
            if matrix[i][j] == matrix[i-1][j] == matrix[i][j-1]:
                dp[i][j] -= dp[i-1][j-1]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD
    
    return dp[n-1][m-1]
